properties.description: Four tests on a real store: a write reaches disk with nobody asking; writes spread over three seconds still cost one export; a hand edit survives untouched AND loop_status carries the reason in `next`; a read-only server refuses the write-through. The debounce test carries its own warning — the obvious version of it passed with the debounce set to zero, because ten back-to-back writes coalesce whatever the quiet period is.
properties.name: the_server_keeps_the_export_current.rs
